instructions:
GOAL: Build the Start-Adventure screen styled as a BOUNTY BOARD (GDD 'Start Adventure'): it shows THREE randomly-drawn Adventures at a time as cards, a reroll button to redraw the three, and tapping a card opens a details view with a Start button that begins that Adventure. It is reachable from Character Select. This is a UI/feel/layout screen verified VISUALLY via headless snapshot — no sim test.

HARD RULES (honor verbatim): NEVER edit anything under game/test/** or game/accept/**. src/render/** MAY use performance.now for animation; but this screen must NOT introduce any dependency from src/sim/** onto render. Anything random on this screen (which 3 adventures are drawn, reroll) must be DETERMINISTIC given a seed: use the sim's seeded rng (src/sim/rng.ts) seeded from a numeric seed, OR a small pure hash of a seed integer you increment on reroll — do NOT use Math.random (so snapshots are reproducible). Keep the gate green. Placeholder art is fine (the atlas swaps real art in later).

GROUNDING FACTS (confirmed): screens in this project are classes in src/render/<name>.ts with `init(app, ...callbacks)`, `show()`, `hide()`, `sync(screenW, screenH)`, a `readonly root = new Container()`, and are constructed + wired in main.ts (see charselect.ts, worldmap.ts, mainmenu.ts). main.ts calls each screen's `sync(W, H)` every ticker frame. Textures come from `getTexture(key)` in src/assets/registry.ts, which returns a placeholder synchronously and swaps in real atlas art asynchronously — so a Sprite must RE-PULL `getTexture(key)` every frame in sync() and reassign `.texture` (and re-apply width/height, because setting .texture recomputes scale), exactly like mainmenu.ts's btnBgs loop and charselect.ts's per-frame texture refresh. Character Select is `CharSelectUI` (src/render/charselect.ts); its init takes an `onBack` callback fired on confirm — today that goes to the world map.

AVAILABLE ART KEYS (seeded, Ready — use these; getTexture returns a labeled placeholder until real art lands): `panel.bounty` (320x420, the board background/frame), `card.adventure` (140x180, one adventure card), `button.reroll` (120x40). Reuse the shared `button.continue` (160x48) look for the Start button if you want a consistent CTA, or draw a Graphics button in the existing style (see charselect _buildSelectBtn / worldmap travelBtn). Pull EVERY sprite's texture per-frame in sync() per the swap pattern above.

ADVENTURE DATA comes from src/sim/adventure.ts (authored in adventure_system.txt): import `ADVENTURES: AdventureDef[]`, `AdventureDef` (`{ id, name, narrativeId, stages: StageDescriptor[] }`), and `getAdventure`. Do NOT redefine the pool here. If adventure.ts is not present yet, guard with a tiny local fallback pool of 3 placeholder AdventureDefs and a labeled TODO to switch to the real import — but prefer the real import.

CREATE src/render/bounty.ts — class `BountyUI`:
- Constructor/fields mirror the sibling screens: `readonly root = new Container()`; a `panel.bounty` background Sprite; a title Text ('BOUNTY BOARD' or 'CHOOSE AN ADVENTURE'); a row/grid of exactly THREE card Containers (each: a `card.adventure` Sprite background + the adventure name Text + a one-line subtitle like biome-count or first biome); a `button.reroll` Sprite button; a details sub-panel (hidden until a card is tapped) showing the selected adventure's name, its 5 stage biomes as a readable list, narrative flavor, and a Start button.
- `init(app, onStart: (def: AdventureDef, party: string) => void, onBack?: () => void)`: build the display list, add root to `app.stage`, set `root.visible = false`. `onStart` is the callback into main.ts's `startAdventure(def, party)` (see adventure_system.txt). `party` = the currently selected character id (read `localStorage['rs_selected_character']`, default 'a').
- Seeded draw: maintain a numeric `rerollSeed` (start from a stable value, e.g. 1 or a value derived from Date-free source like an incrementing counter — NOT Date.now, so snapshots are stable). `drawThree()` uses a seeded rng (rng.ts) or a pure hash of rerollSeed to pick 3 DISTINCT adventures from ADVENTURES (if the pool has <3, allow the whole pool). Store the drawn trio; render their name/subtitle onto the three cards. Reroll button: `rerollSeed++`, redraw, clear any open details, play `audioManager.playSfx('...')` if a suitable sfx exists (optional). 
- Card interactivity: each card Container is `interactive`, `cursor='pointer'`, with pointerover/pointerout tint feedback like the other screens; pointerdown selects that adventure → populate + show the details sub-panel (name, list the 5 stage biomes from def.stages, narrative id/flavor) and reveal the Start button. Start button pointerdown → `hide()` then call `onStart(selectedDef, party)`.
- `show()`: reset to no-card-selected, hide details, `drawThree()` from the current rerollSeed, `root.visible = true`. `hide()`: `root.visible = false`. Add an Escape/back handler mirroring charselect (optional): Escape → hide + onBack?.().
- `sync(screenW, screenH)`: early-return if not visible; center the `panel.bounty` (letterboxed, don't distort — scale to fit with max-size like other screens), lay the three cards in a centered row with even spacing, place the reroll button below/beside the cards, and center the details sub-panel + Start button when shown. RE-PULL getTexture for panel.bounty, all three card.adventure sprites, and button.reroll every frame and reassign texture + re-apply width/height (swap pattern). Recompute all positions from screenW/screenH so it is responsive.

WIRE IN main.ts: construct `const bounty = new BountyUI();` alongside the others; `bounty.init(renderer.app, (def, party) => startAdventure(def, party), () => { bounty.hide(); charSelect.show(); });` (startAdventure comes from adventure_system.txt — if not present yet, stub it and leave a labeled TODO). Reachable from Character Select: change the CharSelect confirm path so that selecting a hero routes to the Bounty board (`bounty.show()`) instead of straight to the world map, per GDD (Character Select → Start Adventure). Keep the world map available as quick-play (e.g. a small 'quick play' affordance or leave the existing hex path reachable) — do not delete it. Add `bounty.sync(W, H)` to the ticker's per-frame sync block next to the other screens' sync() calls. Ensure main.ts's 'is any menu visible?' guards that gate sim-stepping/rendering also treat the bounty screen as a blocking overlay (mirror how worldMap/charSelect/settings are checked) so the sim doesn't run underneath it.

VISUAL / ACCEPTANCE (headless snapshot): screenshot the Bounty board and confirm — the panel.bounty frame, a title, THREE distinct adventure cards with names, and a reroll button are all visible and centered; tapping a card reveals a details panel listing that adventure's 5 stage biomes plus a Start button; pressing reroll changes which three adventures are shown (and is reproducible for a given rerollSeed). Verify the sim is NOT running/animating underneath (no HUD, no enemies). Placeholder art acceptable. Keep the gate green.

feelConfirmed.by: operator (driver: gate-green + menu/gameplay verified; screens code-verified)
